notes.title: FAQ for racing game R9W.
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hello to all [i]Path Racers[/i]![/p][p]In this article we tried to answer the main questions about the game, our plans and future development.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683645/3beba5aeb26a66801ba7116ec86a801aa18abcf9.png"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]
1. About the Game[/b][/u][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Q: What’s this game about?[/b] 
[b]A:[/b] A dynamic arcade racer with adventure elements, inspired by classic racing games and 2000s sci-fi cartoons. Players compete in interplanetary races for control of the universe, using unique vehicles and magical abilities. 
[/p][p][b]Q: Target audience?[/b] 
[b]A:[/b] Arcade racing fans, sci-fi lovers, and all-age players (E rating). 
[/p][h3][u][b]2. Gameplay & Features [/b][/u] 
[/h3][p][b]Q: What makes this racing game unique? 
A:[/b] Blends arcade racing with deep character stories, interactive tracks ([i]Serpent Seals[/i]),  and a narrative-driven campaign.  

[b]Q: What are [i]Serpent Seals[/i]?[/b] 
[b]A:[/b] Track objects that dynamically alter races (speed boosts/obstacles).
[/p][p][b]Q: How does gameplay work?[/b] 
[b]A: [/b]Races span diverse planets. Players drift, boost, and use racer-specific abilities (tactical arcade-style).
[/p][p][b]Q: How many racers/tracks?[/b] 
[b]A: [/b]Launch: 9 racers, each with unique vehicles/abilities/storylines. Tracks are grouped into biomes (3–5 per biome: cities, deserts, icy wastes, etc.). 
[/p][p][b]Q: Multiplayer?[/b] 
[b]A:[/b] Now, the local split-screen mode (for 2 players) is available, and the full online mode is in development. 
[/p][p][b]Q: Controller support?[/b] 
[b]A:[/b] Xbox gamepads supported. No wheel support (vehicles are too diverse).  
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683645/0ff88c6ad5a343dd7d165251105c24a9907af739.png"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]3. Story & World[/b][/u][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Q: Who is Balt? 
A: [/b]The fox-like alien protagonist from the Rinki tribe, racing to change the universe’s fate. 
[/p][p][b]Q: What’s the story?[/b] 
[b]A: [/b]Balt’s journey across nine worlds, facing rivals and unraveling the Great Serpent’s motives.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Player choices?[/b] 
[b]A:[/b] Linear campaign, but relationships with racers unlock rewards/lore. 
[/p][h3][u][b]4. Technical features[/b][/u][/h3][h3][/h3][p][b]Q: Platforms?[/b] 
[b]A: [/b]PC (Steam) first, consoles later. 
[/p][p][b]Q: System requirements?[/b] 
[b]A:[/b] Minimum:[/p][list][*][p]OS: Win 10 (64-bit)[/p][/*][*][p]CPU: Ryzen 5 2600 / i5-8400[/p][/*][*][p]GPU: GTX 1050 Ti / RX 570[/p][/*][*][p]RAM: 8 GB[/p][/*][*][p]Storage: 6 GB[/p][/*][/list][p]Recommended:[/p][list][*][p]CPU: Ryzen 7 5800X / i5-10600[/p][/*][*][p]GPU: RTX 2060 Super / RX 5700 XT[/p][/*][*][p]RAM: 16 GB[/p][/*][/list][h3][u][b]5. Release & Support[/b][/u] 
[/h3][p][b]Q: Release date?[/b] 
[b]A:[/b] TBA (early production, seeking investors/publishers). 
[/p][p][b]Q: Post-launch plans?
A: [/b]New tracks, racers, and stories planned (model TBD). 
[/p][p][b]Q: How to follow updates? 
A: [/b]Our socials:  X - [/p][p][url="https://x.com/OuroborosStd"]https://x.com/OuroborosStd[/url][/p][p] Discord - [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/x2ry7f4B"]https://discord.gg/x2ry7f4B[/url][/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683645/83a383349c6a071e8e97841dc0efed040b39553e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Don't forget to add the game to your Steam wishlists this fall, we want to conduct a playtest among everyone who adds the game to their wishlist.[/p][p]We'll be glad to see you on the track![/p]
